content: Areyyeḥ i řgens n Arebbi
Ejj aneɣ ad neḥḍa xenni, aqa uřa d ijj zzaywem, umi ɛad din ijj n lwaɛd n wadaf di arraḥet nnes, ad iḍhar ittɣima ɣar ḍeffar ɣar wadaf.
Minzi ittwabarreḥ Řexbar Aṣebḥan ɛawed i neccin, am ittwabarreḥ uřa i nitni, maca awař war d asen infiɛ i yinni d as isřin, minzi tuɣa war dd-ittis ca ak-d l’iman deg inni d as isřan.
Maca neccin, inni yumnen, ad nadef ɣar arraḥet.
Maca am mammec inna:
“Am mammec jjuǧeɣ deg weɣḍab inu: ‘Nitni war dd-ttidfen ca ɣar arraḥet inu!’”
U xzar, řexdayem n AREBBI aqa ttwakemmřent zeg wami tᵉttwagg ddunect,
am mammec inna x ssebt:
“Yareyyeḥ AREBBI zi marra řexdayem nnes deg wass wiss sebɛa.”
Ammu i inna ɛawed deg wawař-a wanita:
“War dd-ttidfen ca ɣar arraḥet inu!”
Umi teqqim belli marra zemmaren ad dd-adfen ɣar arraḥet-a, maca inni umi ittwabarreḥ s Řexbar Aṣebḥan ɣar umezwaru, war udifen ca x ssibbet n řmuɛṣiyyet nsen,
aqa Netta igga ɛawed, awarni aṭṭas n řweqt, ijj n wass nneɣni, am mammec ittwari qbeř aqa Dawud inna:
“Ass-a mařa tesřim i tmijja nnes, war seqsiḥem ca uřawen nwem!”
Minzi mařa tuɣa Yacuwa, mmis n Nun, issidef i-ten di arraḥet, war ɣares ittiři ɛad řhard s uqemmum n Dawud x ijj n wass nneɣni awarni man aya.
S uya ad teqqim aqa din ɛad arraḥet n ssebt i řgens n AREBBI.
Minzi wi yudfen ɣar arraḥet nnes, yareyyeḥ ɛawed zi řexdayem nnes am mammec AREBBI zi tinni nnes.
S uya jjem aneɣ ad nemkabar ḥima ad nadef ɣar arraḥet nni, maḥend war nweṭṭi am mammec wḍan inni war iṭṭiɛen.

Minzi Awař n AREBBI iddar, ixeddem mani ma, iqḍeɛ ktar zi kuř ssif s tnayen n wudmawen, ittakkwaḍ ař abeṭṭu n řeɛmar d arruḥ, ař ttasiɛ jar řemfaṣeř, ař aymir jar waḍuf d iɣsan, uca iḥekkem x tnawi d ixarriṣen n wuř.
Uřa d ict n tmesřact i zzayes dd-ittwaxeřqen war zzayes tᵉttwassnuffar ca, maca marra timesřayin aqa atent ttwaɛarryent, ttwarezzment ɣar tiṭṭawin n Wenni umi i-k-dd i ɣa negg řeḥsab.
Yasuɛ d Arrays nneɣ imɣar n ikehhanen
S uyenni, am ɣarneɣ Arrays n ikehhanen imɣar, Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, Mmis n AREBBI, wenni issgeɛɛden ɣar ujenna, ejj aneɣ ad ncebbar di cchadet nnes.
Minzi war ɣarneɣ arrays n ikehhanen i war izemmar ad yaca ak-d tuḍɛeft nneɣ, maca Ijjen wenni ittwajarrben di marra am neccin, maca břa ddenb.
S uyenni ejj aneɣ ad dd-nqarreb xenni s ttiqqet ɣar řɛarc n arḍa nnes, ḥima ad neksi arreḥmet uca ad naf arḍa di řweqt n řmeḥnet.
